<thought>The most intense peak (m/z 179.0946) is likely the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈178.0873 Da. The formula C₇H₁₄O₅ has an exact mass of 178.0841 Da, matching the observed mass within a few millidaltons, making it the best candidate.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H14O5</final_answer>
